name: minimax-image
description: MiniMax H3-Image 文生图 / 图片编辑，产物落盘后把路径交回模型。

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.hint: 在 MiniMax 开放平台创建，保存在本机凭据文件里，不会写进项目配置。

fields.label: 模型
fields.hint: 文生图与图片编辑都走 H3-Image；Highspeed 出图更快，两者参数与限制相同。

fields.label: 输出格式
fields.hint: 默认 jpeg。png 无损但体积大，webp 体积更小。

fields.label: 返回形式
fields.hint: url 是先下载再落盘，推荐用；b64_json 直接内联返回，但总像素面积有上限。

fields.label: 前台等待秒数
fields.hint: 生成超过这个秒数就转后台：这一轮立刻放行，不占着对话连接。厂商最长等 600 秒，转后台后界面才不会被卡住。

fields.label: API 地址
fields.hint: 需要走代理或镜像时改这里。

fields.label: 输出目录
fields.hint: 相对工作区的路径，生成的图片会落在工作区内。

edit_image.description: Create a new image from 1-16 reference images plus a text prompt with MiniMax H3-Image, and save the results into the workspace. Returns the saved file paths. Reference images are workspace-relative paths (JPG/PNG/WEBP/HEIC), public https URLs, or data URLs; their order defines the numbering you can use in the prompt (the first image is '图1'). Use it when the user wants an image based on existing pictures, e.g. swapping a subject, restyling, or changing the background. Generation can take a while: if it is still running when the call returns, you get a background job id instead of a path — read the final result with job_output.

prompt.description: What the new image should look like (max 32000 characters). Describe the change and what to keep from the references. The service always enhances the prompt, so the result may differ slightly from the wording.

images.description: 1 to 16 reference images: a workspace-relative path to a JPG/PNG/WEBP/HEIC file, an https URL, or a data:image/... URL. The order is the numbering used in the prompt. Keep the total request size under 64MB.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio: 'auto' to let the service pick from the content, or 'X:Y' with 1-300 integers such as '16:9', '3:4', '21:9'. The ratio must stay between 1:3 and 3:1. Omit for 'auto'.

n.description: Number of images to generate, 1-10. Defaults to 1.

output_compression.description: Compression quality 0-100 for jpeg/webp output (default 95). Ignored for png.

generate_image.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using MiniMax H3-Image and save it into the workspace. Returns the saved file paths. Use it when the user asks to draw, illustrate, render, or create a picture. The output size follows the area configured in settings and the aspect ratio given here; the service rewrites the prompt for better results. Generation can take a while: if it is still running when the call returns, you get a background job id instead of a path — read the final result with job_output.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the image (max 32000 characters). Mention subject, scene, style, lighting and mood.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio: 'auto' to let the service pick from the prompt, or 'X:Y' with 1-300 integers such as '16:9', '3:4', '21:9'. The ratio must stay between 1:3 and 3:1. Omit for 'auto'.

n.description: Number of images to generate, 1-10. Defaults to 1.

output_compression.description: Compression quality 0-100 for jpeg/webp output (default 95). Ignored for png.
